Usage: notify [options]

Cross-platform desktop notifications + ntfy.sh push notifications.

Options:
  --no-desktop                 Suppress the desktop backend
  --no-ntfy                    Suppress ntfy even if env var is set
  --strict                     Exit non-zero if any configured backend fails (default: best-effort)
  --urgency LEVEL              Urgency: low, normal, critical (default: normal)
  --icon PATH                  Icon path (best-effort per backend; macOS ignores)
  --ntfy TOPIC                 Send to ntfy.sh on TOPIC (env: NOTIFY_NTFY_TOPIC)
  --ntfy-server URL            Override ntfy server URL (env: NOTIFY_NTFY_SERVER, default https://ntfy.sh)
  --ntfy-token TOKEN           Bearer token for self-hosted ntfy (env: NOTIFY_NTFY_TOKEN)
  -h, --help                   Show help
  --version                    Show version
  --no-color                   Disable colored output
  --json                       JSON output
  --describe                   Structured JSON metadata for AI agents
  --color[=auto|always|never]  Coloured output: auto (default when omitted), always, or never

Examples:
  notify "build done"                             Send a desktop notification
  notify "tests done" "5 of 200 failed"           Title and body
  notify "deploy done" --urgency critical         Critical urgency — sound + attention
  notify "alert" --ntfy myalerts                  Send to desktop AND push to ntfy.sh/myalerts
  NOTIFY_NTFY_TOPIC=alerts notify "see you"       Env-set ntfy topic — applies to all calls in the shell
  notify "server warn" --no-desktop --ntfy phone  Push only — useful in headless CI

Composes with:
  long-cmd; notify "done"                 Append to a long-running command
  timeit slow-script.sh && notify "done"  Time + alert pattern

Exit Codes:
  0    Success — at least one backend succeeded
  1    Strict mode — at least one configured backend failed
  125  Usage error: bad flags, missing TITLE, no backends configured
  126  All backends failed
